why: After v3-g0-jkrumm the stylelint preset reports what is left of jkrumm's own broken law: about 62 raw-px sites, 36 hex, 13 viewport queries and the astro findings.
what: src/** (CSS, .astro style blocks, inline styles), package.json (check:basalt gains basalt-ui lint), .basalt/budget.json through the CLI. Profile tokens.
contract: Read-only in ~/SourceRoot/basalt-ui: docs/v3/concepts/static-framework-free.md sections 4.2 and 8 (P7, F-S1); docs/v3/concepts/guardrails.md section 8 (waiver form). The varMap of v3-g0-jkrumm already landed.
exemplar: The seeded-offender fixtures in ~/SourceRoot/basalt-ui/packages/basalt-ui/test/fixtures/lint/stylelint (what each rule means).
change: Run basalt-ui lint and record per-rule counts as BEFORE in the PR. Fix at source: hex to var(--vx-*) or src/lib/tokens.json; raw px spacing and type to --vx-rhythm-*, --vx-text-*; radii and shadows to --vx-radius-*, --vx-shadow-*; viewport queries to container or intrinsic layout; astro findings as reported. The ResumeSheet print sheet keeps its literal colours behind one counted waiver with a reason; optical offsets take a one-line waiver with a reason. If more than 40 waivers would be needed, stop and signal with per-rule counts. Then append basalt-ui lint to check:basalt, remove lint:basalt, and land the count with basalt-ui lint --stats --write-budget (never edit .basalt/budget.json by hand).
commits: Per jkrumm.com: conventional commits, direct to master (ship via push), no attribution.
proof: make check; after the push make verify exits 0.
acceptance: basalt-ui lint exits 0; before and after counts per rule (hex, raw px, viewport, astro) are in the PR; every waiver has a reason
make check exits 0 and check:basalt includes basalt-ui lint
rg -n '#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b' src/styles src/components | rg -v 'stylelint-disable' prints only lines inside a waivered block (listed in the PR)
out_of_scope: Content, tokens, type and boot script (v3-g0-jkrumm), previews, new React or Tailwind, deploy config.
